decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the product feed to identify actual speakers, as several items were accessories like charging cables, battery replacements, or wall shelves. From the remaining options, I selected five speakers with high ratings and diverse features for the consideration set. I ultimately chose the NOTABRICK Portable Speaker (prod_bluetooth_speakers_168) because it offered the best balance of audio power (20W), durability (IPX7 waterproof), and high customer satisfaction (4.6 rating). While the MRCOOL night light speaker was appealing for its multifunctionality, the NOTABRICK speaker appears to be a better dedicated audio device for the price.
